requirement.description: Missing lookup_domain method in Design class
requirement.contract: The Design class must implement a lookup_domain method that takes a domain name and fragment context, returning the corresponding ClockDomain object. This method should properly resolve domain names considering domain renamings and hierarchies.

SimulatorRegressionTestCase test methods should properly accept ctx parameter in testbench functions. The testbench functions need to be updated to correctly pass the context to the simulator processes.
requirement.acceptance: All SimulatorRegressionTestCase tests should pass (test_latch, test_async_reset, test_struct, etc.)

requirement.description: Fix RTLIL memory read/write port handling
requirement.contract: The RTLIL conversion for memory read/write ports must correctly handle synchronous and asynchronous memory operations, including proper port definitions and initialization.
